## Valid ejection targets
`p-1`, `p-3`, `p-5`, `p-6`, `p-8`, `p-9` — or "SKIP".

## How to decide
Your maximum suspicion among the living ejection targets is **0.70**.

A suspect two independent witnesses place at the scene, or whose account one of the conflicts above contradicts, is a stronger case than one carried by a single voice. Remember the vent mechanic: an impostor vents BETWEEN rooms invisibly, so your own sightings of someone leaving or being elsewhere earlier do NOT clear them of a witnessed vent. If your strongest suspicion points at a row tagged OUT OF THE GAME, that case is already closed — the dead cannot be voted, so weigh only the LIVING targets and SKIP if none of them carries the case on its own. Every EJECT names its evidence: the transcript turn that convinced you (in "primary_reason_id"), or the [obs ...] memory line that did (in "primary_reason_observation_id"). A SKIP states its basis too: when a transcript turn or one of your own [obs ...] memory lines is what decided you against naming anyone, put that id in the matching slot and set "decision_basis" to "cited"; when you genuinely hold nothing that resolves, leave both ids null and set "decision_basis" to exactly "none_held" — that word and nothing else. Whichever you write, your vote is recorded as you cast it: nothing here moves your target or turns your SKIP into something else. Set "confidence" to your honest probability that the call is right, judged against the evidence you cite — a case you can barely source deserves a low number, and a case you cannot source at all deserves a SKIP. The numbers on this page are for your decision, not for your mouth: never quote a suspicion score or any other bookkeeping figure in "rationale_text" — say what you saw.

- "counter_reason_id" is the strongest thing you hold pointing AWAY from the name you just wrote — the line that most nearly talked you out of it. When you wrote SKIP, that is the strongest thing you hold pointing TOWARD ejecting someone — the line that most nearly made you name a name. - Copy an id VERBATIM from between the brackets that open a transcript turn's line, WITHOUT the square brackets themselves and with nothing appended to it, or copy a memory line's id without its tag word. An id you shorten, extend or invent is not one of this meeting's, and it is nulled.

Memory-citing — "My own log decides it: I watched that MEDBAY vent myself, and nothing said tonight outweighs it." Keep the whole object compact: a long rationale can overrun the output limit and truncate the JSON, which discards your vote.
</output_format>
